_min_tradable_equity_usd_note: Operator override of the derived floor. The derived value is what every enabled book needs to hold a position AT ONCE; below it the first book to fire consumes the budget and the rest sit margin-blocked, which looks from outside like books that do not fire (W-FUND1). $26.0 also acts as a drawdown brake: the system stops rather than grinding down.
_sizing_note:
2026-09-06, operator's call: DEPLOY THE PORTFOLIO. Sizing is equity-FRACTION, not fixed dollars - default_notional_usd is 0, which routes the books through strategy_book_equity_frac in executor.py (~L885). Each position is 0.30666 x equity x 3x leverage, so 3 slots commit 92% of equity as margin and the deployment holds at ANY balance instead of drifting as a fixed dollar figure would.
WHY 92% AND NOT THE 98% ASKED FOR: min_available_margin_pct is 8% because of the 2026-07-22 equity bleed - at a 1% floor the xyz dex ran to 97% utilization and every adverse tick FORCE-LIQUIDATED positions at ~5%, BEFORE the backup stop could fire, each liquidation draining the shared margin into the next. 98% deployment sits at that same utilization on that same dex. 92% is the most the account takes without reproducing it; the difference is $2.08 at a $34.67 balance, and it buys back the stop being the thing that closes a losing trade.
THE RISK IS THE STOP, NOT THE KILL. A fully deployed book cannot be bounded by a daily kill: the kill halts NEW entries, it does not close open ones. Numbers at any equity E:
  one position stops    13.8% of E
  daily kill            27.6% of E   (trips after ~2 stop-outs)
  all 3 stop together   41.4% of E   <- the real worst case, declared in max_correlated_drawdown_pct
xyz shorts run ~0.83 mean pairwise correlation (W-MATH2/3), so treat the 3-way stop as the LIKELY bad day, not a tail.
The kill was moved 20% -> 27.6% because at this deployment one position stopping is 13.8% of equity: a 20% kill would have halted the bot on its FIRST loser. A kill below one stop-out is hair-trigger; a kill above a full stop-out is decoration. It has to sit between, and test_books_only_gate asserts both ends.
ABSOLUTE USD CEILINGS ARE OFF (0 = inactive): max_trade_notional_usd, strategy_book_notional_usd, short_notional_usd. Under fraction sizing a fixed dollar ceiling silently clips the position as equity grows, with no log line. The percentage caps scale and do the bounding instead.
SIZING IS CHECKED AT THE FLOOR ($26), where the fraction produces its SMALLEST order: $23.92 notional, still clear of HL's $10.5 minimum. A config that only works at today's balance starts refusing orders exactly as the account shrinks.
TO CHANGE DEPLOYMENT: move min_available_margin_pct and strategy_book_equity_frac together - they must sum to 100% across the slots. tests/test_live_config_coherence.py will tell you everything else that has to move.
_xyz_concentration_note:
max_xyz_short_names 3 = max_concurrent, so the name cap never refuses a slot the concurrency budget already approved. It used to sit at 2 with max_concurrent 2 and produced 'REFUSED SHORT xyz:SNDK - xyz-short name cap reached (2/2)' while slots were free.
max_xyz_short_notional_pct 2.815 is the deployment expressed as notional: 92% of equity as margin x 3x = 2.76x equity, plus 2% slack. It is a PERCENT and has to be - it scales with the account, where a dollar cap would go stale in both directions.
Why it is not smaller: xyz shorts are ~1.28 effective bets at 0.83 mean pairwise correlation (W-MATH2/3; seven stopped together on 07-21 for -$8.59). The gate measures NOTIONAL and is right to - a correlated 15% move costs 15% of notional whatever the leverage. Sizing the book therefore means accepting a 41.4% correlated drawdown, which is why that number is declared explicitly in max_correlated_drawdown_pct rather than left implied.
_disabled_books_note: 2026-09-07: news_surge_short and news_surge_multi DISABLED on their own live forward record, graded by scripts/grade_forward_ledger.py against the panel. news_surge_short: 385 distinct bets (270 clusters, 145 coins), NET EV -2.093% after funding, halves +0.62 -> -4.71, P(true edge >= 0) = 0.046. news_surge_multi: 365 bets (233 clusters, 142 coins), NET -1.748%, halves +1.54 -> -4.52, P(true edge >= 0) = 0.084. Both were positive in their first half and fell off a cliff in the second - edge decay, not a bad week, and the samples are large enough to say so. They also competed for the 3 concurrent slots, so a losing book was directly displacing xs_reversal. Re-enable only on a fresh forward sample that is positive in BOTH halves; the loop's inline 'VALIDATED n=255 EV25 +1.24%' comments are the ORIGINAL in-sample claims and are what the live record has now contradicted.
